{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |CoachRank= |APRank= |mode=Basketball |year=2017–18 |team=Rutgers Scarlet Knights |image=Rutgers Scarlet Knights logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=Big Ten Conference |division= |short_conf=Big Ten |record=15–19 |conf_record=3–15 |head_coach=[[Steve Pikiell]] |hc_year=2nd |asst_coach1=[[Karl Hobbs]] |asst_coach2=[[Brandin Knight]] |asst_coach3=[[Jay Young (basketball)|Jay Young]] |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[Louis Brown Athletic Center]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2017–18 Big Ten men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball team''' represented [[Rutgers University–New Brunswick]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Scarlet Knights, led by second-year head coach [[Steve Pikiell]], played their home games at the [[Louis Brown Athletic Center]] in [[Piscataway, New Jersey]] as fourth-year members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 15–19, 3–15 in [[2017–18 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in last place. In the [[2018 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Minnesota]] and [[2017–18 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]] before losing to [[2017–18 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]] in the quarterfinals. ==Previous season== The [[2016-17 Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball team|Knights]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 15–18, 3–15 in [[2016–17 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in last place. In the [[2017 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]] in the first round, marking their first ever Big Ten tournament win.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400945734|title=Rutgers vs. Ohio State - Game Recap - March 8, 2017 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-03-09}} However, they lost to [[2016–17 Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball team|Northwestern]] in the second round.{{Cite news|url=http://www.nj.com/rutgersbasketball/index.ssf/2017/03/rutgers_northwestern_big_ten_tournament_rapid_reac.html|title=Big Ten tournament run ends for Rutgers as Northwestern rolls 83-61 {{!}} Rapid Reaction|work=NJ.com|access-date=2017-08-11|language=en-US}}{{Cite news|url=http://www.chicagotribune.com/sports/college/ct-northwestern-rutgers-big-ten-basketball-spt-0310-20170309-story.html|title=Northwestern dances past Rutgers in 83-61 rout, into Big Ten quarterfinals|last=Greenstein|first=Teddy|work=chicagotribune.com|access-date=2017-08-11|language=en-US}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
